mostWorthwhile.text: Following fallen wood through fungal decomposition to renewed growth made nutrient recycling clear and connected.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial rainfall-and-air combination was less engaging because its connection to the goals was not yet clear, and it was the only gameplay option.

surprise.text: Forest transpiration can contribute to clouds and rainfall far downwind.

arbitrary.text: Rainfall plus air felt somewhat arbitrary before the result explained that it represented a wind-driven storm.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: the contrasting decomposition and peat routes made the environmental processes interesting to follow.
